blocks.content: Explore a heatmap to see how each cell combines a time, a span of numbers, and a count.

Find the **Linear** heatmap. This panel answers the question: How many values fall in each range, and how does that change over time? Time runs along the horizontal axis. The size of the numbers runs up the vertical axis, and each row covers a span of numbers. Color shows how many values are in each cell. A cell higher up covers bigger numbers, not more values. Use the color legend to see which colors mean higher counts, and hover over a cell to read its time, the span of numbers it covers, and its count. Follow a band of occupied cells from an earlier time to a later time. Notice whether the values stay in similar ranges or move higher or lower. The heatmap adds the timing that a single histogram leaves out.
Read the legend rather than assuming darker or redder always means more. These are spans of numbers, not healthy or unhealthy states.
